author: NewsTongueX
text:
🔴 Viral hantavirus map conflates news coverage with confirmed cases

A map from https://t.co/HTXcKkmEDd circulating on X and TikTok has been misrepresented as showing confirmed hantavirus infections across Europe and North America. Social media users claim red and orange markers indicate case locations; Spain appears with 18 markers, but only 2 confirmed cases linked to the MV Hondius outbreak exist there.

The website creator, Bas Witkop, told Euronews' fact-checking team the tool aggregates news reports and alerts, not confirmed infections. The site includes a disclaimer stating it shows "news signals, not confirmed cases."
